description: Rules and current funding for one perpetual futures contract on one exchange: mark price, size step, minimum size, price tick, maximum leverage, funding rate per interval and annualised. Use when a limit price or leverage must fit the venue; not needed for market orders (sizing and preview round for you). Not for comparing exchanges (use compare_venue_prices or compare_funding_rates). Inputs: symbol (base coin, e.g. BTC), venue (without an account: hyperliquid only). Prices in USD per coin, sizes in the base coin, rates as fractions. Next: size_position.

venue.description: Venue: sandbox, hyperliquid, okx, bybit or binance. Omitted: the agent's only venue, else hyperliquid if connected, else your only connected exchange, else the sandbox

name: get_contract_rules

deprecation.description: Present only while this tool is deprecated: replacement, removal_date, changelog

funding_annualized.description: funding_rate scaled to a year, as a fraction

funding_rate.description: Funding rate per interval, as a fraction (0.0001 = 0.01%); positive: longs pay

max_leverage.description: Highest leverage the venue allows for this contract

min_size.description: Smallest order, in the base coin (e.g. BTC), not USD

price_tick.description: Smallest price increment, USD per coin

size_step.description: Smallest size increment, in the base coin (e.g. BTC), not USD

title: Perpetual contract rules
